components.name: View
components.notes: Yoga layout, background, corner radius and opacity. Border, clipping and transform limits are listed below. With the default-OFF accessibility bridge enabled, Pi400 evidence covers native generic View semantic queries and actual React registered activate delivery with semantic-label updates. Qt action-list/custom-label parity, RN disabled semantic state, values and reader output remain unqualified.

components.name: Text
components.notes: Styled, wrapped text and numberOfLines ellipsis. Inline attachments have zero size.

components.name: Image
components.notes: Data URIs, Metro assets and HTTP(S) loading; load events and a header-aware bounded memory cache. See [image loading](image-loader.md).

components.name: ScrollView
components.notes: Qt Flickable scrolling, lifecycle events and scrollTo/scrollToEnd. zoomScale is reported in metrics; visible content scale stays 1.

components.name: TextInput
components.notes: Controlled/default text, focus/blur, edit/selection/key/submit events and basic styling. Pi400 proof uses synthetic Qt input through actual React with the default-OFF TextInput contract enabled: edit counts, UTF-16 selection and Tab/Backtab focus traversal. Physical HID, software keyboard, IME provider and assistive technology remain unqualified.

components.name: Pressable
components.notes: Host pointer press delivers onPress. Pi 400 synthetic Qt input exercises real React Pressable/responder dispatch and remount recovery; physical HID, RNGH and Worklets remain unverified.

components.name: FlatList
components.notes: Scroll-following virtualization, off-window cell release, onLayout and onContentSizeChange are host-tested.

components.name: VirtualizedList
components.notes: Covered transitively by the FlatList virtualization test.

components.name: SectionList
components.notes: Renders through VirtualizedSectionList, ScrollView and VirtualizedList; host-tested.

components.name: VirtualizedSectionList
components.notes: Direct component coverage is unverified.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Mounts and reports presses; opacity press animation reaches the connected NativeAnimated backend.

components.name: TouchableOpacity
components.notes: Mounts through the responder system and uses NativeAnimated opacity. Responder coverage comes from Pressable.

components.name: TouchableHighlight
components.notes: Direct component coverage is unverified.

components.name: TouchableWithoutFeedback
components.notes: Direct component coverage is unverified.

components.name: ImageBackground
components.notes: Composes View and Image; paints the image behind children and forwards resizeMode.

components.name: KeyboardAvoidingView
components.notes: Renders children as a View; behavior, keyboardVerticalOffset and enabled are ignored because no Keyboard module is wired.

components.name: ActivityIndicator
components.notes: Qt Quick spinner with animating, color, hidesWhenStopped and size.

components.name: RefreshControl
components.notes: Renders nothing; refreshing and onRefresh are accepted and ignored. Pull-to-refresh is absent.

components.name: Modal
components.notes: Viewport-sized overlay above scrolled content with background pointer/wheel blocking. Escape dispatches onRequestClose to the application; onShow and onDismiss remain unwired. Keyboard-focus containment requires separate qualification.

components.name: SafeAreaView
components.notes: Mounts as a View with zero insets. System safe-area integration is absent.

components.name: Switch
components.notes: Renders and toggles; value, disabled, tint props and onValueChange are host-tested.

components.name: StatusBar
components.notes: Static API calls have no effect. The target has no status-bar integration.
